correctness.rationale: Each interaction edge of L(G) lies in exactly one base-vertex triangle and each spin appears in two triangles. Local energy Phi=sum_{i<j}s_i s_j+(delta/2)sum s_i²-(b/2)sum s_i has six relevant minimizing triples; assigning their three labels to a proper base-edge colouring realizes local minima simultaneously, giving exact n*min of six affine forms. Uniquely minimizing compositions force perfect matchings or labeled 3-edge colorings; at D=J,h=0 occupied components are alternating even cycles, and at h=4J,D<0 negative-spin edges form arbitrary matchings. Independent direct full 3^6 configuration enumeration on K4 reproduced strict regimes and both boundary counts 7 and 10; source also provides cube and K3,3 checks. Finite checks corroborate the universal decomposition.
